request:
镜头 s06：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：固定机位，缓慢推近。深夜的实验室，宋工一个人坐在台灯下，把女儿的蜡笔画用胶带贴在新笔记本的第一页，用手掌抚平，抬头隔着玻璃看了一眼机房里那枚红色镜头。环境声：机房的低频嗡鸣、撕胶带的声音。
情绪：quiet, solitary, contemplative
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, tripod camera with one slow push in
景深与虚实：Focus on Song and the notebook; the server hall behind the glass is soft, the red lens a glowing blurred point.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Night in the institute laboratory: Song sits alone at the long cluttered workbench under a desk lamp, taping the child's crayon drawing onto the first page of an open hardback notebook; behind him a large glass wall shows the cold server hall and the single red-glowing lens on the central black cabinet. Blocking lock: Song sits at the workbench at frame left under the desk lamp, the notebook in front of him; the glass wall fills the right half of the frame with the server hall and the red lens glowing at frame right.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
Picture 4: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：low hum of the server hall, the rip of tape, a desk lamp buzzing faintly
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, tripod camera with one slow push in from medium shot to medium close-up, the framing slightly off-level and imperfect as if the operator set it late; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Song sits at the workbench at frame left, three-quarter turned toward the notebook, the warm desk lamp catching the side of his glasses and cheek; the open notebook lies in front of him just below frame centre; the cluttered workbench edge with loose papers and a mug sits in the near foreground; the glass wall fills the right half of the frame, the server hall beyond it in soft cold blue-grey, and the red lens glowing low at frame right. Start: his left hand holds the notebook's first page down flat while his right hand pinches a strip of yellowed tape free of a small roll, the tape lifting and curling slightly at the corner. Middle: he lays the tape along the top edge of the crayon drawing, presses it down with the pad of his thumb, then opens his palm and draws it slowly across the whole page from the centre outward to smooth the paper flat, the paper easing under his hand, the notebook spine creaking. End: his palm stays flat on the page, he lifts his chin and turns his head a few degrees toward frame right, looking through the glass wall at the red lens, his eyes steady behind the round steel rims, a slow breath moving his shoulders, and he holds that look. Mood: quiet, solitary, contemplative. Blur: Song's face, hands and the notebook stay sharp; the server hall behind the glass is soft and hazed, the red lens a glowing blurred point at frame right, the near foreground workbench falling out of focus. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low steady hum of the server hall through the glass, the sharp rip of tape from the roll, faint buzz of the desk lamp, soft paper crackle and the creak of the notebook spine under his palm, the brush of a cardigan sleeve on the bench, one slow breath, a distant ventilation whine; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
